meta.title: Bronya · Companion
meta.description: A high-resolution Bronya character sprite made from the user-supplied sailor-outfit artwork, standing in the bottom-right corner of the interface. On load, a cyberpunk pixel boot splash displays all six supplied photos uncropped and edge-blended into the background, with edge-blurred photos, falling pixel Tetris blocks and a pixel-plane battle, over a warp tunnel, portal rings, speed rays, glitch flashes, HP/EN/LV game HUD and a neon loading bar, with the welcome line 「欢迎探索未来，为世上一切美好而战」; it enters DSH after the sixth image and can also be skipped. Her original wink, blush and yellow rabbit plush are preserved, and the old face overlays are disabled. Moving the pointer near her raises pink ripples and orbiting hearts; hovering adds more. Four raster chimeras are cut directly from the supplied references and stay inside the input bar: the pink winged cherry-bow fairy, the charcoal cat with red hibiscus and paper fan, the red fish-hugging cat, and the mint eyepatch cat with a tiny dragon. They walk, jump, eat star snacks, roll, stack all four, and emit colourful particles on hover. The composer card is restyled as a cyberpunk pixel input with a blue-purple animated light flow, drifting pixel lettering, neon borders and glow; user message bubbles use a translucent theme-aware fill with backdrop blur. The whole DSH UI uses a rounded bold font with pink text and pink neon shadows. On the Plugins and Schedules pages the companion and the same themed panel background remain visible. A cyberpunk pixel balance HUD in the sidebar footer shows the signed-in DeepSeek account balance, refreshing every 10 seconds or on click. The main conversation background is replaced with the supplied Q-version Silver Wolf artwork with its white border cropped away, fixed to cover the whole view with the same scrim strength as the sidebar; the left sidebar also layers a low-opacity animated flow with two pixel rockets, two cute pixel girls, a gamepad, a planet, hearts and stars without hiding the background photo. The sidebar uses a high-resolution cosplay photo with no extra blush. The top bar uses a pixel game HUD with vivid light flow and drifting pixel game consoles, ringed planets, character heads, gamepads, cartridges, stars and hearts, while the conversation header carries a pink heart-and-star flow. She rotates 32 idle lines every 10 seconds, replies according to the question, and rotates 32 shy, intimate hover lines. Character art supplied by the user; background photos by @本体is眼镜 on 米游社.
